title: How Kepler built verifiable AI for financial services with Claude
translatedTitle: Kepler 如何用 Claude 为金融服务构建可验证的 AI
subtitle: Inside a platform that indexes 26M+ SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, IR presentations, consensus estimates, and private data across 14,000+ companies and 27 global markets, and how the team behind it built AI that validates every number to the exact filing, page, and line item.
